name: CLARIVATE PLC

priced.reason: not a repriceable fcff name or no growth supplied

devils_advocate.strongest_counter: That three refusals on one name is the engine failing rather than the analyst being careful, and that the facts have actually changed this time: the disposal has closed, proceeds are being applied to debt in a documented tender, ACV growth turned positive in IP for the first time in three years, and the market has just voted 35% on it. If the true WACC is 8% rather than 15.19% then the equity is worth something like $6 against $2.33, and declining to say so for a third time means the position 'the WACC is unoverridable' has become a way of never having a view on any levered company.
devils_advocate.what_would_prove_it: Organic revenue growth converting from the 1.8% ACV figure, and the post-tender debt balance. ACV leads revenue by roughly a year at this company, so the 2027 prints settle whether the turn is real.
devils_advocate.already_visible: The ACV turn is visible and it is genuinely new — 1.8% organic ACV for continuing operations, positive in IP for the first time in three years, is the first forward-looking improvement this name has shown across three passes. What is also visible is how small it is in absolute terms, and that the trailing lines are still falling: organic revenue +0.4% in the quarter and +0.1% over nine months, adjusted EBITDA down 1.8% over nine months, revenue down 22.7% year on year on the disposals, and the analyst consensus still 'Reduce'. So the counter establishes that the business has stopped deteriorating, not that it is growing. And it does not touch the arithmetic that forces the refusal: at a 31%-of-enterprise equity, the difference between an 8% and a 12% discount rate is the difference between $6.29 and $1.27 a share. I cannot measure the discount rate — beta is 0.896 at an R-squared of 0.053, which is not a measurement — and the schema cannot carry a correction even if I could. Publishing a fair value here would be publishing my own choice of WACC with a decimal point on it, which is what the 2026-09-18 pass did when it recorded $0.04.
devils_advocate.unresolved: The post-tender capital structure, which I cannot pin down: the 2026-11-04 tender was still open when this pass ran, so I do not know the final debt balance, only that it is roughly $600M lower than the $4,167M the engine carries. I also cannot separate the sustainable free cash flow of the continuing business from the $233.1M of nine-month free cash flow that still includes the sold segment, because the company has not yet reported a clean continuing-operations cash flow year.

what_changed: A great deal, and it breaks the engine's inputs in both directions at once. THE DISPOSAL CLOSED: the $600M sale of the Life Sciences & Healthcare segment to Altaris completed 2026-10-06 (8-K items 2.01/5.02/8.01/9.01), after the 2026-09-30 balance sheet, and LS&H is now presented as discontinued operations. So the enterprise value of $5.40bn carries total debt of $4,167,377k as at 2026-09-30, BEFORE the proceeds were applied — and the 2026-11-04 8-K announces fresh cash tender offers for outstanding debt securities, the third such exercise since September, which is the proceeds being spent. Corrected for roughly $600M of debt reduction, enterprise value is nearer $4.8bn, so the engine's EV is about 12% too HIGH and the name looks dearer than it is. Running the other way, the cfo_series of [$628.5M, $646.6M, $744.2M] is fiscal 2025/24/23 and every one of those years INCLUDES the segment that has just been sold, so the $628.4M base describes a company that no longer exists — the HOG and VISN shape. The company's own current figures: nine-month operating cash flow $399.0M and free cash flow $233.1M, both including LS&H. Organic revenue +0.4% in Q3 and +0.1% for nine months; organic subscription +1.5%, re-occurring +0.7%, transactional down. Stifel's initial 2027 outlook puts free cash flow growth at 9-18%.
consensus_case: The market is not valuing a business here, it is pricing a thin equity stub on top of a large debt stack, and that is why the stock moved 35% in five days on news that moved the enterprise perhaps nine per cent. At $2.33 the equity is $1.49bn against roughly $3.3bn of net debt — about 31% of enterprise value — so every point of enterprise re-rating arrives in the equity three times over. What the market bought in early November is a turn, not growth: organic ACV for continuing operations grew 1.8%, the Intellectual Property segment posted positive ACV growth for the first time in three years, adjusted EPS of $0.21 beat $0.18, and Clarivate completed the $600M sale of Life Sciences & Healthcare to Altaris on 2026-10-06 and is applying the proceeds to debt. Against that: Q3 organic revenue for continuing operations grew 0.4%, nine-month organic revenue grew 0.1%, and adjusted EBITDA including LS&H FELL 2.8% in the quarter and 1.8% over nine months. The equity is a levered option on a flat business deleveraging.
base_case_rationale: No number is recordable, for the third consecutive pass on this name, and the reason is structural rather than a matter of effort: the input that sets the SIGN of the answer is the one the schema cannot reach, and it is levered. The engine's WACC is 15.19% at a 74% debt weight, built from a synthetic cost of debt near 17% because `ebit` reads $71.5M against `dep_amort_series` of [$757.2M, $727.0M, $708.3M] and $7.16bn of intangibles — an EBIT carrying roughly $700M a year of purchase-accounting amortisation, giving interest coverage of 0.24x and a distressed synthetic rating. The rate Clarivate actually pays is $293.7M on $4,167.4M, about 7.05%, and the debt market has priced it directly: its 3.875% senior SECURED notes due 2028 cleared a tender at $975.15 per $1,000 in September. A company whose secured paper clears at 97.5 cents is not rated distressed by the people lending to it. Because the equity is only about 31% of enterprise value, that WACC error is geared: the 2026-09-25 pass computed the equity at $1.27 a share at a 12% WACC, $3.16 at 10% and $6.29 at 8%, and nothing in this quarter narrows that. Per the rule that pass established — where the equity is under about a third of enterprise value, an un-overridable WACC is a refusal rather than a caution — and because the base and the enterprise value are themselves broken in opposite directions, no final_growth is supplied.
key_risks: The equity is about 31% of enterprise value, so the un-overridable 15.19% WACC decides the sign: the equity prices between roughly $1.27 and $6.29 a share across an 8-12% discount rate against a $2.33 price
Organic revenue growth is +0.4% in the quarter and +0.1% over nine months, and adjusted EBITDA FELL 1.8% over nine months — the 35% move paid for an ACV inflection of 1.8%, not for growth

The engine's enterprise value of $5.40bn predates the application of $600M of disposal proceeds to debt, so it is roughly 12% too high; the cfo_series simultaneously includes the segment that was sold, so the base is too high as well — two large errors in opposite directions

EBIT of $71.5M against $757.2M of D&A and $7.16bn of intangibles produces a 0.24x synthetic coverage ratio and a distressed credit rating for a borrower whose secured notes cleared a tender at 97.5 cents
Third appearance on this screen and the third refusal; a 0.053 R-squared beta means the cost of equity is not a measurement either
Analyst consensus remains 'Reduce' after the move, and revenue fell 22.7% year on year on the disposals
watch_for: The final results of the 2026-11-04 cash tender offers — the post-deal debt balance is the one input I could not pin down
Whether 1.8% organic ACV growth converts into organic revenue growth above 1% during 2027; ACV leads revenue by roughly a year here
A full clean year of continuing-operations free cash flow, which is the first base this name could honestly be modelled on
Whether adjusted EBITDA stops declining — it has fallen in both the quarter and the nine months
A selection-time gate on the synthetic-versus-actual cost of debt, and on an item 2.01 dated after balance_sheet_asof: both fire on this name and neither is read
